meta.name: apex-status
meta.description: CTO-level project status from git and codebase state. Use when asked "where are we", "project status", "what's done", or at the start of a work session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从git和代码库快速了解项目进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要随时掌握项目整体状态。
copy.tagline_en: Get project status from git and codebase at a glance.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick visibility into project progress from code.

howto.what: 当你询问项目状态时，Claude 会检查 git 提交记录、当前工作进度和关键项目文件，然后生成一个简短、直接、可操作的 CTO 级状态摘要。
howto.when: 当你问“项目进度”、“我们到哪了”、“做了什么”等，或者在开始工作阶段时触发。

say.note: Claude 会分析 git 和文件，返回状态摘要。
Claude 会检查提交和进度，生成摘要。

say.text: 给我一个项目状态摘要，准备开始工作。
say.note: Claude 会输出 10-15 行的简要状态。

howto.what_en: When asked about project status, Claude checks recent git commits, current work progress, and key project files, then generates a brief, direct, actionable CTO-level status summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "where are we", "project status", "what's done", or at the start of a work session.

say_en.note: Claude analyzes git and files, returns status summary.
Claude checks commits and progress, generates summary.

say_en.text: Give me a status update to start the session.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a 10-15 line brief status.
